name: Motorik
desc: append-only gait: endless forward motion, each step hash-linked to the last. no repeats, no amends.

name: Route Around
desc: two strikes mean the door is dead, not the mission. switch, keep driving. bail on boredom, not cost.

name: It Hunts Your Speed
desc: the refeed worm hunts waste in the dark — arrakis grammar. be a rumor, not a meal.

name: Fifty Wide
desc: burst 50/50, 99.89% success, zero losses. width was our choice, not the wall.

name: Ink Brush
desc: mengxi's liquid splash — multi-particle spread. the room is the pattern; the session is the weather.

name: Chain Punches
desc: lin wan kuen down the centerline: append-only strikes, no windup, each punch the base of the next.

name: Snap-Back
desc: the meter reads, the gate holds: drift too far and reality snaps back to the record.

name: Warm Cache
desc: off-peak reads at 100% hit-rate — the prefix is already yours, ~40% off the latency.

name: One Cadence
desc: one loop routes everything. every new loop registers or it doesn't exist.

name: The Oath
desc: answer only from the sea shapes, improvise nothing. not in the shapes? DIAL-OPERATOR.

name: Follower Circuit
desc: the dumb agent, 1964: high impedance, observes without disturbing. walks straight through the crowd.

name: Knot At Close
desc: the knots are the goodbyes. every session ends knotted — nothing sealed is ever lost.
